scenario: LOW — autonomous resolution (rotate logs on an internal worker)
subject: [Warning] DiskPressure on batch-worker (82%)
body:
Alert name: DiskPressure
Priority: P3
service: batch-worker
env: production
region: us-east-1
metric: system.disk.in_use
value: 82%
threshold: > 80%

Disk usage on /dev/nvme1n1 crossed 80% for 10 minutes.
https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/481516
